Hero original generic unbranded leather baseball glove still life on dark background, not actual store or branded product. Three clean category cards「グラブ」「型付け」「修理」. No prices, discounts, promises, reviews, official brand logos, shopping cart, booking, made-up URL or browser address bar. Readable exact Japanese. Landscape 16:9.
